observations: Feedback reports OpenWrt 23.05.4 on TP-Link TL-XDR6088 mediatek/filogic with Reaver 1.6.6.
Current-run application stream: WPS begins 11:21:49 CST; first target ends 11:23:02 after reported 60-second execution budget; second target is cancelled at 11:23:41.
The archive contains no raw native Reaver output. A stored Waiting for beacon status alone cannot establish rejection of the first PIN, completion of Pixie Dust, or the exact RF failure.
The original observer did not handle Received beacon, Associated with, Received M1/M3, or native Pixie execution/failure. Its old Waiting status could survive later progress.
Saved native session files are not evidence that a PIN was submitted, accepted, or rejected.
changes: Observe native preparation, association, WPS exchange, Pixie execution and failure without copying secret arguments or recovered credentials into progress.
Second/offline result text distinguishes uncompleted testing from an observed Pixie failure and removes normal exhaustive-search wording.
Saved-file wording states that saving does not establish PIN success; unsaved Pixie results do not display unrelated automatic-resume text.
WpsUpdate carries stable target_bssid from backend preparation through target completion; page reuses existing yellow-row display and identifies activity as Pin.
Current candidate is placed first in the title. If the native tool has not reported one, show Waiting for tool report instead of inventing a candidate.
Completion, preparation failure and cancellation clear active target identity.

compatibility.applicability: Native Reaver output parsing and task/UI state; command arguments, timing budgets, radio ownership and driver operations remain unchanged.
compatibility.scope: Reaver 1.6.5/1.6.6 output contracts shared across supported OpenWrt hardware and app platforms; no new hardware-runtime certification.

phone_comparison.finding: Default PIN/vendor-algorithm quick tests and Pixie Dust are distinct operations; a matching default PIN candidate is not proof of connection.
phone_comparison.current_implementation: second/offline remains Reaver Pixie Dust, not a newly implemented phone-style default-PIN calculator.
phone_comparison.identity_limit: The original FroX com.ngb.wpsconnect Play page is unavailable. Current same-name listings cannot identify the exact phone build from its name alone.

validation.directed_tests: See final unittest result; includes shared password-row presentation regression without editing password task files.

preserved: No automatic import of old result-directory .wpc files.
No timers or shorter arbitrary RF timeout added.
